title.zh: 杠杆与滑轮 · 力矩与省力
title.en: Levers & pulleys · torque and mechanical advantage

description.zh: 杠杆平衡看力矩：两边的力 × 力臂相等，所以把支点挪近重物就能用小力撬起大物；但省力必费距离——手做的功等于重物得到的功，滑轮组省几倍力就要多拉几倍绳。
description.en: A lever balances when the torques match — force × lever arm on each side — so moving the fulcrum toward the load lets a small force lift a big one; but saved force always costs distance: the work you put in equals the work done on the load, and a pulley system that divides the force by n makes you pull n times as much rope.

aliases.zh: 为什么撬棍能撬起大石头
aliases.en: how can a crowbar lift a heavy rock

reason.zh: 理想的杠杆和滑轮不会产生能量：输入功 F·s 等于输出功 G·h，力小几倍，移动的距离就大几倍。
reason.en: An ideal lever or pulley creates no energy: input work F·s equals output work G·h, so dividing the force by some factor multiplies the distance moved by the same factor.

reason.zh: 物体静止要求合力为零；能绕支点转动的物体还要求两边力矩相抵，杠杆平衡 F₁l₁ = F₂l₂ 就是这条转动平衡条件。
reason.en: A body at rest needs zero net force; one that can turn about a pivot also needs the torques to cancel, and the lever rule F₁l₁ = F₂l₂ is that turning-balance condition.
